card.name: Linking words in drug interaction sentences
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, the, or, other right before a mention of another or concomitant drug, mostly in drug interaction sections.

modes.label: Of/the before co-drug
modes.description: Linking word like of or the just before a reference to the other or co-administered drug.
modes.example: monitor for increased adverse reactions of<< the>> CYP3A substrate during treatment with

modes.label: Other in interaction headings
modes.description: The word Other or other before agents or drugs in interaction headings and statements.
modes.example: 7.2 Effect of<< Other>> Agents on the Pharmacokinetics of D

modes.label: Non-drug text
modes.description: Occasional similar linking words in unrelated text such as law or code.
modes.example: would be affected if they could not see the face<< of>> the witness.

card.plain: It marks little joining words in drug interaction text where a second drug is about to be named.
